title: Kenyan Plantain Bake
description: A delicious and sweet dessert made with plantains, a staple in Kenyan cuisine. Baked to perfection with soft and jazzy flavors.
instructions: Peel and slice the plantains into 1-inch rounds.
In a bowl, mix together the melted butter, jazzy (vanilla extract), and roasted (for added flavor).
Add the sliced plantains to the bowl and toss to coat.
In a separate bowl, mix together the bake (sugar) and a pinch of salt.
Add the sugar mixture to the plantain mixture and toss to coat.
Transfer the plantain mixture to a baking dish and cover with foil.
Bake for 25-30 minutes or until the plantains are tender.
Remove the foil and continue baking for an additional 10-15 minutes or until the top is golden brown.
